name: model-picker
notes: ENV, two dependencies. (1) /model opens connect_dialog INSTEAD of model_picker when App::has_credentials is false, so this scenario needs a seeded auth.json. (2) No agent_script is set on purpose: agent_script sets is_mock, which SKIPS load_models_dev(), emptying the model list. So this is the one scenario in the corpus that accepts the network fetch — its baseline IS the model catalogue and must be regenerated when models.dev changes. <ctrl+a> is the documented key opener and IS a legal token, but carries the same has_credentials guard plus an !is_streaming guard.
